method: Exact float64 prediction-minus-truth residuals and frozen candidate utilities; byte transpose + XZ lossless compression
offline_replay: Five main models: all primary CSV columns, per-choice values, all 15 model choices, six paired cluster intervals. Uses original unrounded residuals, not stored MSE scalars.
external_replay: All 15 raw RNA matrices, original objective projection, individual-seed RNA metrics and 30 trained model weight replays require identified external assets.
precision: Every stored compact array is bitwise SHA256 checked. Reference table validation uses rtol1e-12/atol1e-14 and records actual maximum error; BLAS versions can change final rounding. Cross-hardware retraining is not claimed bitwise identical.
